7.4.title: Waste Disposal and Contractor Management Procedure
7.4.text:
Waste disposal must:

• Be undertaken by licensed and approved waste contractors
• Comply with applicable legal and regulatory requirements, and
• Include appropriate documentation or tracking where required

Contractors must be managed in accordance with Contractor Risk Management Procedure
(IMS.03.03.PRO.01).

4.1.2.title: Verra Mobility Employees
4.1.2.text:
Verra Mobility Employees are required to:

• Segregate waste in accordance with provided instructions and signage, and

• Use designated waste storage and disposal.

4.2.1.title: Verra Mobility Employees
4.2.1.text:
Verra Mobility Employees are required to:

• Complete the Waste Risk Management Procedure (IMS.03.24.TRN.01) annually.

7.5.title: Recycling and Resource Recovery Procedure
7.5.text:
Where practicable, recycling and reuse must be implemented to reduce waste sent to
landfill, including:

• Recycling of paper, cardboard, plastics, and metals
• Recycling of electronic waste through approved providers, and
• Reuse of packaging materials where safe and appropriate.

4.2.title: Competency Requirements
4.2.text:
4.2.1. Verra Mobility Employees
Verra Mobility Employees are required to:

• Complete the Waste Risk Management Procedure (IMS.03.24.TRN.01) annually.

7.3.title: Waste Segregation, Storage and Handling Procedure
7.3.text:
Waste must be:

• Segregated at the source using designated containers
• Stored securely to prevent environmental release or exposure, and
• Handled in a manner that minimises risk to people and the environment

Incompatible waste must not be mixed.

4.1.title: Specific Roles and Responsibilities Related to this Procedure
4.1.text:
4.1.1. Leaders
All Leaders are responsible for:

• Identifying waste-related risks within their area of responsibility
• Ensuring waste risks are assessed and controlled prior to work commencing
• Ensuring appropriate waste segregation, storage, and disposal arrangements are
implemented, and
• Ensuring only approved and licensed waste contractors are engaged.
4.1.2. Verra Mobility Employees
Verra Mobility Employees are required to:

• Segregate waste in accordance with provided instructions and signage, and

• Use designated waste storage and disposal.

7.2.title: Waste Identification and Classification Procedure
7.2.text:
Waste must be identified and classified to ensure appropriate handling and disposal.
Common waste categories include:

• General waste (non-recyclable)
• Recyclable waste
• Organic waste (where applicable)
• Electronic waste
• Hazardous waste, and
• Confidential waste.
